zh.title: 桌面无代理更新直连修复
highlights: 修复未配置代理时更新误走代理路由、在 0 字节处报 proxy_configuration 的问题；无代理下载恢复直连，代理回退行为不变。
v3.37.0 / v3.37.1 需手动覆盖安装 3.37.2 一次，之后恢复正常自动更新。

en.title: Desktop direct-download fix without a proxy
highlights: Fixed updates incorrectly selecting a proxy route without a configured proxy and failing at zero bytes with proxy_configuration; direct downloads now work while proxy fallback is unchanged.
Manually install 3.37.2 once over 3.37.0 / 3.37.1; subsequent automatic updates will work normally.
